items.title: EAN 2026: Bocunebart’s promise as migraine preventive in treatment-refractory patients
items.summary: Bocunebart's PACAP-targeting mechanism positions it as a potential first-in-class therapy in a thin pipeline of novel late-stage candidates

items.title: QuantumCell commits $2.2bn on AlzeCure’s Alzheimer’s platform
items.summary: The lead product on AlzeCure’s platform has already demonstrated positive Phase I results.

items.title: Sanofi aims for Nexviazyme approval in younger Pompe disease patients
items.summary: In Sanofi's Baby-COMET trial, Nexviazyme met all primary and secondary endpoints, teeing it up for potential label expansion in Pompe disease.

items.title: Surge in RMAT designations awarded by the FDA
items.summary: The number of RMAT designations awarded by the FDA increased sharply from 2024, reaching a record of 48 RMAT designations in 2025.

items.title: EAN 2026: Real-world data supports safety and efficacy of AbbVie’s Vyalev in Parkinson’s
items.summary: The real-world data study tracked Parkinson's disease patients for 12 months during treatment with AbbVie's Vyalev
